null_hypotheses.toy: H0_TOY: at least one width fails complete-fill standard execution of [IN,OUT,END].
null_hypotheses.regional_witness: H0_REGION: the single E15-selected witness does not naturally exercise all three regions at every intermediate width.

vm_profile.memory: materialized unsigned-32 array of exactly 3^k cells
vm_profile.self_encryption: Classic printable-ASCII XLAT after non-halting steps

regional_witness.selection: Selected by E15 exploration before this cross-width preregistration; unchanged for every width.
regional_witness.success: complete fill, standard start, HALTED within fuel, and visited regions exactly including 0,1,2
regional_witness.controls: For each passing width, increment region-1 and region-2 offsets independently; require the first opcode in the altered region to differ.

execution_order: ascending E11 through E18; every result retained even after a failure
failure_policy: Record the first failing width separately for TOY and REGION. A witness failure does not by itself falsify the offset formula.
resource_policy: Allocation failure or host timeout is recorded as NOT_DEMONSTRATED, never coerced to semantic FAIL.
claim_rule: FULL_VM_TOY_Ek is DEMONSTRATED only on its own gate. NATURAL_ALL_REGION_Ek is DEMONSTRATED only on target plus controls. Universal claims require every width to pass.
baseline: E15 full-VM toy and natural-region experiments already demonstrated and are rerun in the common native runner.
scope_exclusion: No external canonical oracle exists for E11-E18; this evaluates the frozen parametric profile.
